title: Quantifying Confounding Bias in Generative Art: A Case Study
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally concerned with the ethical implications of AI-generated art. It addresses ethical questions such as whether AI models stereotype artists and do justice to the socio-cultural nuances of art movements. The core contribution is a metric to quantify confounding bias, which is framed as an ethical problem of misrepresentation and stereotyping. The work aims to trigger discussions about the accountability of AI systems in creative applications.
